tasks.subject: Task 1: Define AbstractArchitecture, CPU, GPU{B} in src/core/architecture.jl
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the foundation architecture type hierarchy with allocation and array-movement primitives; export them from the module.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/architecture.jl`
- Modify: `src/GeoDynamo.jl`
- Modify: `src/api/grids.jl`
- Test: `test/gpu_backend.jl`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/core/architecture.jl", "src/GeoDynamo.jl", "src/api/grids.jl", "test/gpu_backend.jl"], "verifyCommand": "julia --project -e 'using GeoDynamo; @assert CPU() isa AbstractArchitecture; @assert arch_zeros(CPU(), Float64, 2) == zeros(Float64, 2); println(\"ok\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CPU <: AbstractArchitecture is defined", "GPU{B} <: AbstractArchitecture is defined with a backend::B field", "arch_zeros(CPU(), Float64, 2, 3) == zeros(Float64, 2, 3)", "on_architecture(CPU(), [1,2,3]) isa Array", "get_backend(CPU()) isa KernelAbstractions.CPU", "GPU, CPU, AbstractArchitecture, arch_zeros, on_architecture, get_backend are exported from GeoDynamo"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Parameterize SolverBackend{A}, TransformWorkspace{T,A}, SolverRuntime{T,A}, SolverState{T,A}
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Thread the architecture type parameter through the four key solver structs so Julia can specialize solver dispatch on architecture at compile time.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/solver/backend.jl", "src/solver/state.jl", "src/solver/mainloop.jl"], "verifyCommand": "grep -n \"architecture === :gpu\\|solver_gpu_device\\|device::Symbol\" src/solver/backend.jl", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SolverBackend{CPU} constructs and has field architecture::CPU", "TransformWorkspace{Float64, CPU} constructs and has field arch::CPU (not device::Symbol)", "SolverRuntime{Float64, CPU} constructs", "SolverState{Float64, CPU} constructs", "solver_create_shtns_config dispatches on arch type", "create_transform_workspace takes arch directly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Replace SHT dispatch + delete old GPU system
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace all 8 if uses_gpu branches with arch-dispatched overloads; delete GPUBackendState, _GPU_BACKEND, and all interop wrappers.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/solver/numerics.jl", "src/solver/interop.jl", "src/GeoDynamo.jl", "src/physics/nonlinear.jl"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rn \"_GPU_BACKEND\\|GPUBackendState\\|register_gpu_backend\\|uses_gpu\\b\\|solver_gpu_device\\b\" src/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["grep for _GPU_BACKEND|GPUBackendState|register_gpu_backend|with_gpu_backend in src/ is empty", "grep for uses_gpu|solver_gpu_device in src/ is empty", "grep for SOLVER_GPU_BACKEND|SOLVER_GPU_SCALAR|SOLVER_GPU_VECTOR|SOLVER_GPU_SCRATCH in src/ is empty"]}
```
